Yes, that's the right direction — you've captured it well.

Just so we're on the same page as you build it out, that summary is the heart of it, but there are a handful of everyday things I'd naturally expect to go along with those. For example, being able to edit or delete something I've saved, tidy up the details if the auto-grabbed title isn't quite right, and — this is a big one for me — if I try to save a link I've already saved, I don't want a duplicate; I'd expect it to just take me to the one I already have.

But I don't want to overload you all at once. That direction is right, so let's go with it.
